in_text_mentions: The CT scan of the chest revealed a large, well-circumscribed, destructive lytic lesion (11.7 × 13.1 × 11.2 mm) that had extended into the left lung and mediastinum, confirmed as chondroma by histological analysis. Additionally, a CT scan demonstrates numerous lesions on the sternum, left 5, 6, and 7 ribs, scapula, and humerus (on both sides) with a maximal size of 60 × 49 × 44 mm. There are numerous nodular lesions with calcifications on the anterior chest wall, the largest of which can measure up to 2.3 × 1.0 cm (Figure 3).
